messages.text: Wednesday, November 25 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast stillness and the rhythm of a jazz-infused Tuesday

The day remains quiet and gray as we approach the end of November. Local interest turns toward downtown music venues, while the scientific community marks a significant potential breakthrough in mathematical theory.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 43 degrees and a low around 26 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:37 AM and sets at 5:05 PM, with the moon currently full and 99.2% illuminated.
Music to fill the quiet

Guitarist Jordan Smith-Hays performs a free solo set at North Star Lounge in Ann Arbor at 5:30 PM. Alternatively, Caleb Robinson and Reaching bring their blend of jazz and R&B to Cliff Bell's in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
A meeting is scheduled for this evening at 6:30 PM.
Work halted at data center site

Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for the Project Cannoli data center in Van Buren Township. The action was taken after officials determined the project lacks required construction permits and may negatively impact county drains.
Looking toward Wednesday
Prepare for a shift in weather as rain is expected tomorrow with temperatures reaching 45 degrees.

Thursday, November 26 · Canton, Michigan
Rainy pavement, stop-work orders, and a puzzle of prime numbers

A steady rain settles over Canton today as the community navigates a pause in local industrial development. Meanwhile, global mathematics reaches a potential turning point with new AI-assisted proofs.
Expect a rainy day with temperatures reaching a high of 46 degrees and falling to a low of 33 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:38 AM and sets at 5:04 PM, with the moon currently in a waning gibbous phase at 96 percent illumination.
A quiet day indoors
With heavy rain forecasted, it is a suitable day to stay inside and catch up on local reading or prepare for upcoming community events.
Mark your calendar for December 3, when Hamtramck hosts a free night of improv comedy at the Black Box starting at 9 PM.
Permit issues halt data center work

Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for the Google-linked Project Cannoli data center in Van Buren Township. Officials cited a lack of required construction permits and potential risks to county drainage infrastructure.
Looking toward next week
Consider attending the Last Call Improv show in Hamtramck on December 3 for a free evening of live entertainment.
